summary: iter355 H-1 (Bidder KYC via Stripe Identity + Pre-Auth Bid Holds) tested end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 iter355 unit tests PASS. 8/8 new live-endpoint tests PASS (auth gate, session create/reuse, real Stripe VerificationSession client_secret returned, KYC gate envelope, admin bypass, non-regression buyer login). Regression: 73/77 prior tests PASS (4 skips, 0 failures). Frontend: /verify-identity ProtectedRoute redirect works, all 4 primary data-testids visible (verification-page, verify-state-idle, verify-start-btn, verify-skip-btn), Stripe publishable key loads with zero console errors, Skip button navigates away as designed.

minor.issue: Requires JSON body (VerifyRequest{return_url}). Docstring/spec examples that show calling without a body will get 400 validation_error. Consider marking body Optional or accepting empty POST for maximum ergonomics.

Real Stripe VerificationSession client_secret format is `vs_<id>_secret_live_...` (not `vs_client_secret_...` as stated in review spec). Endpoint returns real, valid Stripe live secret — spec expectation on prefix was inaccurate; endpoint behavior is CORRECT.

integration_issues.issue: For admin user, navigates to /admin (Admin auto-redirect kicks in from /dashboard). For a fresh buyer w/o phone verification, navigates to /verify-phone (phone-verification global guard from /dashboard). This is expected downstream behavior — the Skip button itself correctly navigates away from /verify-identity to its default returnTo=/dashboard, but /dashboard has separate auth-flow guards.

action_items: None blocking. Feature ready to ship. Optionally: mark POST /api/identity/verify body as Optional so callers can POST without JSON payload (frontend already sends {}, this is cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: KYC soft-gate order-of-checks is correct: listing/settlement lookup runs FIRST (404 on missing), then KYC gate (403 IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED with bilingual envelope). Admin bypass path present at both /settle/{listing_id} and /vehicles/{vehicle_id}/buyer-acknowledge.

BidConfirmationDialog hold logic at line 373: `!isVehicle && bidAmount > 500` — matches backend should_require_hold() semantics exactly. Hold amount clamped to [50, 500] CAD which mirrors compute_hold_amount() (10% of bid, floor $50, ceiling $500).
VerificationPage.js: loadStripe guarded by presence of REACT_APP_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (null if missing) — good defensive posture.
Stripe VerificationSession reuse logic verified working live: same session id returned on 2nd call with reused=true.
Live 8/8 endpoint tests all pass (auth, status, verify create+reuse, settle KYC gate, admin bypass, buyer-acknowledge KYC gate, non-regression login).
